title: Accept your award in 60 minutes
scenario: A scholarship email says another candidate will receive your award if you do not accept within 60 minutes. Acceptance requires a $25 “identity processing” fee and a photo of your student ID.

answers.A: Verify the award through the scholarship organization’s official site and your university financial-aid office before paying or uploading ID.
answers.B: Ask for formal award terms and whether the fee can be deducted from the scholarship rather than paid upfront.
answers.C: Pay the small fee to reserve the award, then verify before sending the ID.

explanation: Scarcity plus congratulations can bypass skepticism. Legitimate awards should be independently verifiable before money changes hands.
proTip: Winning should create funding, not a payment emergency.
